title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E15 — The Courtship of Mark Cooper
Mark is in the midst of defending himself in court when he realizes the plaintiff's lawyer is an ex-girlfriend he dumped brutally.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E17 — Everybody Hates The Ex-Cons
Chris attempts to help Malvo, a criminal who was recently released from jail, turn his life around by going back to high school. Rochelle is alarmed by the parenting skills of one of Tonya's friend's parents and decides to share her wealth of knowledge.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E18 — Everybody Hates Mother's Day
Chris decides to buy his mother an expensive bottle of perfume for Mother's Day to pay her back for all the things she has done for him, but when he learns that it costs much more than he anticipated, Chris buys an imposter version of the perfume.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E19 — Everybody Hates The First Kiss
After finding out that Tasha is going to 'spin the bottle' parties, Chris is determined to get an invitation to the next party so he can finally experience his first kiss.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E20 — Everybody Hates Easter
When Tasha breaks up with her boyfriend, Chris is more than happy to step in and serve as her escort for the Easter Pageant, but first, he has to figure out how to be in two places at the same time without his mother finding out.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E21 — Everybody Hates The 9th Grade Dance
Chris and Greg are without dates to the ninth-grade dance until Greg gets asked, leaving Chris as the odd man out. Ms. Morello suggests to Chris that he ask the only girl who hasn't been asked yet, Carrie White, and she accepts.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E22 — Everybody Hates Graduation
Chris' excitement about graduating from junior high school is ruined when Greg announces that he'll be going to a different high school in the fall.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E1 — Everybody Hates Tattaglia
As a first-time high school student, Chris is really looking forward to attending a school with some diversity.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S4 E2 — Everybody Hates Cake
Chris agrees to help a classmate, Angel improve his grades if Angel will help him get the attention of Chris' latest crush, Maria. Rochelle reluctantly befriends an ex-con, Peaches who has moved back into the neighborhood, but her good deed backfires.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E5 — The Big Don't Leave Me This Way Episode
Mona becomes completely absorbed in her career as she is working on a talent search idea for Delicious. She realizes that she can't balance work, family and friends and decides that it is okay to focus on her career at this point in her life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E6 — THe Big No-So Loyal Family Episode
When Dee Dee realizes that Mona has become friends with a woman she has had a long history of competing against, she tells Mona that she has to choose between this new friend and her own sister.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E7 — The Big Don't Go Chasing Waterfalls Episode
To try to give his career a jumpstart, Spencer goes after signing a notorious bad-boy performer, but he has his hands full when the singer isn't as reformed as he led people to believe.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E8 — The Big My Life And Kids Episode
Dee Dee is torn when she gets a date with a great man whom she admires, but she discovers he is divorced with two kids. At first, she rejects the idea of dating him, but she reconsiders and has a great time with his family.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E9 — The Big Thanks For Nothing Episode
High drama occurs and secrets are revealed at Dee Dee's Thanksgiving party when Spencer's father, Ray, shows up unexpectedly. Mona comes clean to her father about her feelings of being slighted by him and Phyllis rethinks her relationship with Ray.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E10 — The Big Parent Trap Episode
Dee Dee musters up the courage to finally introduce her new boyfriend, the older Morris, to her parents. Though Charles and Big Dee Dee publicly approve, privately they try to get Dee Dee to break it off.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E11 — The Big Home Is Where The Car Is Episode
When Mona discovers that her new boyfriend is living in his car, she sets out to prove that she's not so shallow that it makes a difference. Meanwhile, Phyllis puts her war with Big Dee Dee on hold to help her weather a health scare.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E12 — The Big All Bets Are Off Episode
Mona, Dee Dee, Phyllis and Big Dee Dee have trouble getting along when they all play poker together at Mona's apartment. When Dee Dee loses to Mona she has a hard time accepting that she may not be the best at something.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E13 — The Big Credit Check Episode
Mona gets upset when her boss, Kai, seems to take all the credit for the Delicious Records talent search. However Kai explains that she will have to take the fall if the promotion fails, so she has to take control.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E14 — The Big Performance Anxiety Episode
Mona has her leadership skills put to an impromptu test when her boss leaves her in charge of her fellow employees at the company’s bonding retreat.
